question: Which of the following union territories recorded the highest sex ratio at birth in India in 2020 as per annual report on vital statistics based on Civil Registration System Report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ladakh recorded the highest sex ratio at birth in India in 2020,** with 1,104 females per 1,000 males.
 
• The highest sex ratios were in the states and union territories:
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh (1,011), Andaman and Nicobar Islands (984), Tripura (974), and Kerala (969). **
 
 
 
• **​**The **sex ratio is the number of females per 1,000 males.**
 
• It's a **fundamental indicator that affects many aspects of society, including reproductive potential, marital status, workforce, migration patterns, population growth, and socioeconomic relationships**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Civil Registration System (CRS) in India,** emphasizes its **critical role in the compulsory and continuous recording of vital events such as births, deaths, and stillbirths.**
 
• This system is integral f**or socio-economic planning, impacting areas such as healthcare, education, and governance.**
 
• The** report also underlines significant progress in the registration rates over the years, with registered births rising to 89.3% in 2018 from 81.3% in 2009, and deaths from 66.9% to 86.0% in the same period.**
 
• However, challenges remain, particularly in achieving timely and uniform registration across various regions, especially in rural areas.
